Elias climbed the lighthouse stairs, bucket in hand, to collect the salt that crusted every window. On the lowest step lay a bottle, green as old grief, sealed with black wax. Inside, a map had been folded so many times that its creases were nearly transparent. It showed the island, the reef, and a small X beside the lighthouse itself. Beneath it, in faded ink, one line: You were always closer than you knew. Elias read it twice, then looked up at the brightening walls. Some messages, he thought, do not guide ships home. They guide the keeper.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的寂静里。高楼的窗灯稀落，像未熄灭的星；街道被夜雨洗过，泛着湿润的光。环卫车缓缓驶过，扫帚划过路面，发出细碎而清醒的声响。便利店亮着暖黄的灯，蒸汽在玻璃上凝成薄雾。远处早班车的第一声鸣笛，轻轻碰了碰楼宇的轮廓。有人推开窗，让凉风掠过桌角；城市尚未醒来，却已在呼吸。","w03":"- Think of a story that says, “Tell this same story, but with one fewer page.”\n- You keep opening smaller versions until you reach the last page, which gives you a simple answer.\n- Then you walk backward, handing each answer to the page before it, until the first story gets the full answer."}
